gemv_m1.note: Triton M=1 GEMV on 3 shapes; L2 rel err 5e-6/1.9e-4/0; L4 same-tool A/B 64.32 -> 65.24 tok/s (+1.4%), 5 vs 3 runs, 512 prompt/1024 out PLANS holds TP8-local (N, K) shapes (16384/8, K/8, 1280/8).

ar_prefill.note: tried to size the PCIe-IPC workspace for prefill batches (it is max(capture_sizes)*hidden=16*2560 today, so every prefill AR falls back to NCCL). Enlarging the allocation only (no extra tuning) made prefill SLOWER: 2824 tok/s @7909 and 2612 @31595 vs baseline 3612 @8192 and 3074 @32768 (-15~22%). Root cause: the decode-tuned configs do not transfer to 21MB messages. Rejected 2026-10-26.

gdn_tc.note: tensor-core GDN chunk prefill (mma.sync m16n8k8, borrowed from vllm-turing). REQUIRES --gdn-prefill-backend=triton on the launch line. L2 parity 7.2e-04 vs flashqla; L3 teacher-forced logprob delta 0.0035 nats (noise band 0.002-0.005); L4 prefill +6.5%/+12.0%/+10.1% at ~8K/~32K/~126K.

ar_overlap.note: chunk RowParallelLinear over tokens and issue async all-reduce per chunk so the next chunk's GEMM overlaps the collective; return_bias layers (GDN out_proj) included. Same-image A/B on 2026-10-26: on 2306.6/10081.5 ms vs off 2266.7/10021.7 ms at ~7.9K/~31.6K (5-run medians) - no gain, slightly slower. Only ~48 of ~98 AR launches per prefill step are reachable here; MoE reduce (48) and embedding/PLE stay outside. Rejected under the 1% gate and left default-off.

ar_q8_probe.note: MEASUREMENT ONLY, not an optimization. Quantizes the row-parallel prefill output to fp8-e4m3 (per token) while the all-reduce itself stays fp16, to measure the precision cost an 8-bit collective would pay. Gate: run L3 teacher-forced logprobs with VLLM_SM75_AR_Q8_PROBE=0/1 and compare against the 0.002-0.005 nats noise band before writing any collective kernel.

qsa_slice.note: Larger row slices in QSASelectedPrefillFP8.run (upstream fixed at 1024 rows). Each slice costs Python/launch overhead with the GPU idle; FlashInfer workspace_size is 0, the only cost is the pages buffer (2.1 MB -> 8.4 MB at 4096 rows). Env VLLM_SM75_QSA_SLICE_ROWS=2048/4096/8192. Math unchanged (same runner, same rows per attention call, only batched larger). Measured 2026-10-27 on row 26 (opt12): 8K 2019.1 -> 2000.7 ms (-0.9%), 32K 8643.5 -> 8646.1 ms (+0.0%); not the source of the prefill gaps. Default off, kept for reference.

qsa_timing.note: MEASUREMENT ONLY. Wraps the QSA selected-page run/_prepare/runner.run with perf_counter and logs calls slower than VLLM_SM75_QSA_TIMING_MS (default 2 ms), to attribute the GPU-idle gaps seen before _selected_subpages. No behavior or precision change.

prefill_tail_overlap.note: L2/L3 FAIL (2026-10-28): tail-off 8K single-segment L3 mean -1.65726 (RUNS=2); tail-on with the shared TP communicator -3.20358, delta 1.546 nats (gate 0.002-0.005) = silent wrong sum; tail-on with the default new group hangs the first 8K prefill (sample_tokens RPC timeout). Root cause: side AR vs MLP internal collectives (stream/communicator ordering) + per-chunk MoE forward context. Do not enable. The earlier 9.54% microbench was a dense-proxy upper bound without EP all-to-all. Layer-tail overlap: the attention core (QKV/QSA/GDN/KV) stays whole-batch; only the per-token tail o_proj -> all-reduce -> HC -> MLP is chunked and the o_proj AR runs on a side stream. Tuning: VLLM_SM75_TAIL_MIN_TOKENS (2048), TAIL_MAX_TOKENS (8192), TAIL_SPLIT (0.16667,0.5,0.83333), TAIL_SIDE_GROUP (new default; same is a diagnostic). A separate side communicator is required because the MLP's internal collectives use the TP communicator. Isolated 8xT10 microbench 2026-10-28: Phase-1 sync proxy +9.54% at 8K, hidden 37.0% of the o_proj AR, chunked AR 1.02x of the 42 MB AR; the MLP there is a dense fp16 proxy with no EP all-to-all, so the number is an upper bound. L2/L3 and a real 64K A/B are pending.
